method: Live MCP continuation and bounded HD-only trial, informed by prior read-only source-support probes. An initial isolated 6 m addition passed source audits but overlapped retained connector 45. Validation rejected the combined patch before spending an attempt. The agent then drafted only 118–120 m, patched, compared, inspected connections and explicitly adopted it. This is not an independent agent benchmark.
